note: The filters of ffmpeg, sorted for the apps. FACTS (shape, works, flags, ffmpeg, since, until, options and their types, ranges, defaults) are written by effects-update.mjs from a real build. WORDING and design are written by a person and kept by the tool: on a filter (role, category, level, plain, what), on an option (plain, what, unit, step, soft, as, escape, required with its ffmpeg source line) and on a choice (plain). `effects` holds the effects that are more than one filter with wording: controls (bound to an option, or their own), steps or a graph or an audio chain, formulas, and `covers` (the filters that leave the picker because the effect replaces them). Every other effect is simply a filter: effects-engine.cjs makes its form from its options. since = the first version a system's build listed the filter, null = that system has not been listed yet, empty = not on that system; until = the first version that no longer had it. Two states only: an option is mandatory (required) or optional.

a3dscope.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song
a3dscope.ffmpeg: Convert input audio to 3d scope video output.
a3dscope.what: Draw the sound as a three-dimensional scope.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. The default is hd720.

options.name: fov
options.what: The field of view of the camera, in degrees, from 40 to 150. The default is 90.

options.name: roll
options.what: How far the camera is rolled, from -180 to 180. The default is 0.

options.name: pitch
options.what: How far the camera is pitched, from -180 to 180. The default is 0.

options.name: yaw
options.what: How far the camera is turned (yaw), from -180 to 180. The default is 0.

options.name: xzoom
options.what: The camera zoom along the X axis, from 0.01 to 10. The default is 1.

options.name: yzoom
options.what: The camera zoom along the Y axis, from 0.01 to 10. The default is 1.

options.name: zzoom
options.what: The camera zoom along the Z axis, from 0.01 to 10. The default is 1.

options.name: xpos
options.what: The camera position along the X axis, from -60 to 60. The default is 0.

options.name: ypos
options.what: The camera position along the Y axis, from -60 to 60. The default is 0.

options.name: zpos
options.what: The camera position along the Z axis, from -60 to 60. The default is 0.

options.name: length
options.what: How many frames of audio waves are shown at once, from 1 to 60. The default is 15.

aap.ffmpeg: Apply Affine Projection algorithm to first audio stream.
aap.what: Adaptive filter that cancels an echo using a second audio stream as the reference.

options.name: order
options.what: The order of the adaptive filter, from 1 to 32767.

options.name: projection
options.what: The projection order of the algorithm, from 1 to 256.

options.name: mu
options.what: The filter's mu value, from 0 to 1.

options.name: delta
options.what: The coefficient used to initialise the internal covariance matrix, from 0 to 1.

options.name: out_mode
options.what: Which signal the filter passes on: the first input, the second input, the corrected difference, the noise, or the estimated error.

options.name: precision
options.what: Which sample precision is used when processing the audio; automatic picks one depending on the other filters.

abench.what: Measure how long a part of the audio filter chain takes.

options.name: action
options.what: Whether this step starts or stops the timer.

abitscope.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song
abitscope.ffmpeg: Convert input audio to audio bit scope video output.
abitscope.what: Draw which bits of the audio samples are in use.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. The default is 1024x256.

options.name: colors
options.what: The colours used to draw the channels, separated by a space or by |. Unrecognised or missing colours are drawn white.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether the bit scope is drawn as bars or as a trace. The default is bars.

abuffer.ffmpeg: Buffer audio frames, and make them accessible to the filterchain.
abuffer.plain: Start of an audio filter chain
abuffer.what: Feed sound into a filter chain from a program.

options.name: time_base
options.what: The time base used for the timestamps of submitted frames, as a floating-point number or as numerator/denominator.

options.name: sample_rate
options.what: The number of channels of the incoming audio buffers. If a channel layout is also given, the two must agree.

options.name: sample_fmt
options.what: The sample format of the incoming audio buffers, by name or by its integer number.

options.name: channel_layout
options.what: The channel layout of the incoming audio buffers, by name or by its integer number.

abuffersink.ffmpeg: Buffer audio frames, and make them available to the end of the filter graph.
abuffersink.plain: End of an audio filter chain
abuffersink.what: Hand the sound to the program that asked for it.

options.name: sample_formats
options.what: The list of sample formats this end of the chain accepts.

options.name: samplerates
options.what: The list of sample rates this end of the chain accepts.

options.name: channel_layouts
options.what: The list of channel layouts this end of the chain accepts.

acompressor.what: Make loud parts quieter so the level evens out.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The gain applied to the input before compression, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether the compressor works downward or upward.

options.name: threshold
options.what: The level above which the signal starts to be reduced, from 0.000976563 to 1.

options.name: ratio
options.what: The ratio by which the signal above the threshold is reduced, from 1 to 20.

options.name: attack
options.what: How many milliseconds the signal must stay above the threshold before gain reduction starts, from 0.01 to 2000.

options.name: release
options.what: How many milliseconds the signal must stay below the threshold before the reduction is lowered again, from 0.01 to 9000.

options.name: makeup
options.what: How much the signal is amplified after processing, from 1 to 64.

options.name: knee
options.what: How softly the sharp bend around the threshold is curved when gain reduction begins, from 1 to 8.

options.name: link
options.what: Whether the average level of all channels or the loudest channel decides the reduction.

options.name: detection
options.what: Whether the exact signal (peak) or an RMS-like level is used to detect the volume; RMS is mostly smoother.

options.name: level_sc
options.what: The gain applied to the sidechain signal, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mix
options.what: How much of the compressed signal is used in the output, from 0 to 1.

acontrast.ffmpeg: Simple audio dynamic range compression/expansion filter.
acontrast.what: Make the sound punchier by expanding or compressing its dynamics lightly.

options.name: contrast
options.what: How strongly the dynamic range is compressed or expanded, from 0 to 100.

acopy.ffmpeg: Copy the input audio unchanged to the output.
acopy.what: Pass the sound on without any change.

acrossfade.ffmpeg: Cross fade two input audio streams.
acrossfade.what: Fade one audio stream out while the next fades in.

options.name: inputs
options.help: set number of input files to cross fade
options.what: How many inputs are cross-faded one after another, like the concat filter. At least 1.

options.name: nb_samples
options.help: set number of samples for cross fade duration
options.what: The number of samples the cross fade lasts; at its end the first input is completely silent.

options.name: duration
options.what: How long the cross fade lasts, as a duration. When set it is used instead of the number of samples.

options.name: overlap
options.help: overlap 1st stream end with 2nd stream start
options.what: Whether the end of the first stream overlaps the start of the second.

options.name: curve1
options.help: set fade curve type for 1st stream
options.what: The shape of the fade for the first stream.

options.name: curve2
options.help: set fade curve type for 2nd stream
options.what: The shape of the fade for the second stream.

acrossover.what: Cut the sound into low, mid and high streams.

options.name: split
options.what: The frequencies where the sound is split into bands; they must be positive and increasing.

options.name: order
options.what: How steep the roll-off of each band split is.

options.name: level
options.what: The input gain, from 0 to 1.

options.name: gain
options.what: The gain of each output band.

options.name: precision
options.what: Which sample precision is used when processing the audio; automatic picks one depending on the other filters.

acrusher.what: Reduce the sound's bit depth for a lo-fi, crunchy effect.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The level of the input signal, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: level_out
options.what: The level of the output signal, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: bits
options.what: How many bits the signal is reduced to, from 1 to 64.

options.name: mix
options.what: How much of the crushed signal is mixed in, from 0 to 1.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether the crushing steps are linear or logarithmic.

options.name: dc
options.what: The DC offset, which crushes the lower and upper halves of the wave differently, from 0.25 to 4.

options.name: aa
options.what: How much anti-aliasing is applied, from 0 to 1.

options.name: samples
options.what: How much the number of samples is reduced, from 1 to 250.

options.name: lfo
options.what: Whether a low-frequency oscillator varies the effect over time.

options.name: lforange
options.what: How far the low-frequency oscillator varies the effect, from 1 to 250.

options.name: lforate
options.what: How fast the low-frequency oscillator runs, from 0.01 to 200.

acue.ffmpeg: Delay filtering to match a cue.
acue.what: Hold the sound until a wall-clock time.

options.name: cue
options.what: The Unix timestamp, in microseconds, at which audio filtering may begin.

options.name: preroll
options.what: How much audio before the cue is passed through, as a duration in seconds.

options.name: buffer
options.what: How much audio is buffered, as a duration in seconds.

addroi.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
addroi.ffmpeg: Add region of interest to frame.
addroi.what: Tell the encoder which area deserves more quality.

options.name: x
options.help: Region distance from left edge of frame.
options.what: The distance of the region from the left edge of the frame, in pixels, as a number or an expression.

options.name: y
options.help: Region distance from top edge of frame.
options.what: The distance of the region from the top edge of the frame, in pixels, as a number or an expression.

options.name: w
options.what: The width of the region, in pixels, as a number or an expression.

options.name: h
options.what: The height of the region, in pixels, as a number or an expression.

options.name: qoffset
options.help: Quantisation offset to apply in the region.
options.what: How much the encoder is asked to change quality in the region, from -1 to 1. A negative value asks for better quality, a positive one for worse, and 0 for no change.

options.name: clear
options.help: Remove any existing regions of interest before adding the new one.
options.what: When on, any regions already marked on the frame are removed before this one is added.

adeclick.ffmpeg: Remove impulsive noise from input audio.
adeclick.what: Take out short clicks and pops, as from old records.

options.name: window
options.what: The size of the window processed at once, from 10 to 100 milliseconds.

options.name: overlap
options.what: How much windows overlap, as a percentage of the window size, from 50 to 95; a very high value removes more noise but is much slower.

options.name: arorder
options.what: The autoregression order as a percentage of the window size, from 0 to 25; it also controls the quality of the interpolated samples.

options.name: threshold
options.what: How strong impulsive noise must be to be removed, from 1 to 100; a lower value detects more samples as noise.

options.name: burst
options.what: As a percentage of the window size, from 0 to 10: noise samples spaced closer than this are joined, along with everything between them.

options.name: method
options.what: How the processed windows are joined together.

adeclip.what: Restore peaks that were cut off by too high a level.

options.name: window
options.what: The size of the window processed at once, from 10 to 100 milliseconds.

options.name: overlap
options.what: How much windows overlap, as a percentage of the window size, from 50 to 95.

options.name: arorder
options.what: The autoregression order as a percentage of the window size, from 0 to 25; it also controls the quality of the interpolated samples.

options.name: threshold
options.what: The clipping detection threshold, from 1 to 100; higher values make detection less aggressive.

options.name: hsize
options.what: The size of the histogram used to detect clips, from 100 to 9999; higher values make detection less aggressive.

options.name: method
options.what: How the processed windows are joined together.

adecorrelate.what: Make the channels less alike, which widens the sound.

options.name: stages
options.what: The number of decorrelation filtering stages, from 1 to 16.

options.name: seed
options.what: The random seed used to set the delay in samples across channels.

adelay.ffmpeg: Delay one or more audio channels.
adelay.what: Delay one or more channels by a number of milliseconds.

options.name: delays
options.help: set list of delays for each channel
options.what: The delay of each channel in milliseconds, separated by |; append S for samples or s for seconds. Channels without a value are not delayed.

options.name: all
options.help: use last available delay for remained channels
options.what: Use the last delay for all the remaining channels.

adenorm.ffmpeg: Remedy denormals by adding extremely low-level noise.
adenorm.what: Add tiny noise so later filters do not slow down on near-silence.

options.name: level
options.what: The level of the added noise, from -451 to -90 dB.

options.name: type
options.what: The kind of very quiet signal that is added.

aderivative.what: Compute the rate of change of the sound, a signal-processing tool.

options.name: m1

options.name: fg1
options.what: The colour of the first graph, given as an expression.

options.name: m2
options.what: The metadata key whose value is drawn as the second graph.

options.name: fg2
options.what: The colour of the second graph, given as an expression.

options.name: m3
options.what: The metadata key whose value is drawn as the third graph.

options.name: fg3
options.what: The colour of the third graph, given as an expression.

options.name: m4
options.what: The metadata key whose value is drawn as the fourth graph.

options.name: fg4
options.what: The colour of the fourth graph, given as an expression.

options.name: bg
options.what: The colour of the graph background. The default is white.

options.name: max
options.what: The largest value shown on the graph. The default is 1.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether values are drawn as bars, dots or lines. The default is line.

options.name: slide
options.what: How the graph moves on as new values arrive. The default is frame.

options.name: size

options.name: rate

adrc.what: Control the level of each frequency band separately.

options.name: transfer

options.name: attack

options.name: release

adynamicequalizer.ffmpeg: Apply Dynamic Equalization of input audio.
adynamicequalizer.what: An equaliser whose gain follows the level of the sound.

options.name: threshold
options.what: The level of the detected signal that triggers equalisation, from 0 to 100.

options.name: dfrequency
options.what: The frequency of the detection filter, from 2 to 1000000 Hz.

options.name: dqfactor
options.what: The resonance of the detection filter, from 0.001 to 1000.

options.name: tfrequency
options.what: The frequency of the equalisation filter, from 2 to 1000000 Hz.

options.name: tqfactor
options.what: The resonance of the target equalisation filter, from 0.001 to 1000.

options.name: attack
options.what: How many milliseconds the detected signal must stay above the threshold before equalisation starts.

options.name: release
options.what: How many milliseconds the detected signal must stay below the threshold before equalisation ends.

options.name: ratio
options.what: The ratio by which the equalisation gain is raised, from 0 to 30.

options.name: makeup
options.what: The offset by which the equalisation gain is raised.

options.name: range
options.what: The largest cut or boost that is allowed.

options.name: mode
options.what: What the equaliser does when the detection threshold is crossed.

options.name: dftype
options.what: The type of the filter used for detection.

options.name: tftype
options.what: The type of the filter used for the equalisation.

options.name: auto
options.what: Whether the threshold is gathered automatically from the detection filter, which lets it follow the audio over time.

options.name: precision
options.what: Which sample precision is used when processing the audio; automatic picks one depending on the other filters.

adynamicsmooth.ffmpeg: Apply Dynamic Smoothing of input audio.

options.name: sensitivity
options.what: How sensitive the smoothing is to frequency fluctuations, from 0 to 1e+06.

options.name: basefreq
options.what: The base frequency for smoothing, from 2 to 1e+06.

aecho.what: Add one or more echoes to the sound.

options.name: in_gain
options.what: The input gain of the reflected signal, from 0 to 1.

options.name: out_gain
options.what: The output gain of the reflected signal, from 0 to 1.

options.name: delays
options.what: The time in milliseconds between the original sound and each reflection, separated by |.

options.name: decays
options.what: The loudness of each reflection, separated by |, each above 0 and up to 1.

aemphasis.what: Apply or undo a recording emphasis curve such as RIAA.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The input gain, from 0 to 64.

options.name: level_out
options.what: The output gain, from 0 to 64.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether to restore (reproduction) existing material or to produce emphasis on new material (production).

options.name: type
options.what: Which recording medium or standard the curve matches.

aeval.ffmpeg: Filter audio signal according to a specified expression.
aeval.what: Rewrite each sample of the sound with a formula.

options.name: exprs
options.help: set the '|'-separated list of channels expressions
options.what: One expression per channel, separated by |; if there are more channels than expressions, the last expression is used for the rest.

options.name: channel_layout
options.what: The channel layout of the output. If not set, it follows the number of expressions; same uses the input layout.

aevalsrc.ffmpeg: Generate an audio signal generated by an expression.
aevalsrc.what: Make a sound from a mathematical expression.

options.name: exprs
options.help: set the '|'-separated list of channels expressions
options.what: The expressions that generate the sound, one for each channel, separated by |.

options.name: nb_samples
options.help: set the number of samples per requested frame
options.what: The number of samples in each frame that is produced. The default is 1024.

options.name: sample_rate
options.what: The number of samples per second, as a number or an expression. The default is 44100.

options.name: duration
options.what: The minimum length of the generated audio. The result may be longer, because the audio is always cut at the end of a complete frame.

options.name: channel_layout
options.what: The channel layout of the generated audio. It must have as many channels as there are expressions.

aexciter.ffmpeg: Enhance high frequency part of audio.
aexciter.what: Add brightness by enhancing the high frequencies.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The input level before processing, from 0 to 64.

options.name: level_out
options.what: The output level after processing, from 0 to 64.

options.name: amount
options.what: How many harmonics are added to the original signal, from 0 to 64.

options.name: drive
options.what: The amount of newly created harmonics, from 0.1 to 10.

options.name: blend
options.what: The octave of the newly created harmonics, from -10 to 10.

options.name: freq
options.what: The lower frequency limit for producing harmonics, from 2000 to 12000 Hz.

options.name: ceil
options.what: The upper frequency limit for producing harmonics, from 9999 to 20000 Hz; below 10000 Hz no limit is applied.

options.name: listen
options.what: Mute the original signal and output only the added harmonics.

afade.what: Fade the sound in or out over a chosen time.

options.name: type
options.what: Whether the sound fades in or fades out.

options.name: start_sample
options.help: set number of first sample to start fading

options.name: nb_samples

options.what: The gain at the start of a fade-in or at the end of a fade-out, from 0 to 1.

options.name: unity
options.what: The gain at the start of a fade-out or at the end of a fade-in, from 0 to 1.

afdelaysrc.ffmpeg: Generate a Fractional delay FIR coefficients.
afdelaysrc.what: Make the coefficients of a fractional-delay filter, for audio engineers.

options.name: delay
options.what: The fractional delay of the filter coefficients, from 0 to 32767. The default is 0.

options.name: sample_rate
options.what: The sample rate of the output. The default is 44100.

options.name: nb_samples
options.help: set the number of samples per requested frame
options.what: The number of samples in each frame. The default is 1024.

afftdn.what: Reduce steady noise such as hiss using frequency analysis.

afireqsrc.what: Make the coefficients of an equaliser from a list of gains.

options.name: preset
options.what: Which equaliser preset to use. The default is flat; custom uses your own gains and bands.

options.name: gains
options.what: The gain for each band in dBFS, separated by spaces. Only used when the preset is custom.

options.name: bands
options.help: set central frequency values per band
options.what: The centre frequency of each band in Hz, separated by spaces, in strictly increasing order. Only used when the preset is custom.

options.name: taps
options.what: The number of filter coefficients in the output audio stream, from 16 to 65535. The default is 4096.

options.name: sample_rate
options.what: The sample rate of the output audio stream. The default is 44100.

options.name: nb_samples
options.help: set the number of samples per requested frame
options.what: The number of samples in each frame of the output. The default is 1024.

options.name: interp
options.what: How the equaliser coefficients are interpolated, linear or cubic.

options.name: phase
options.what: The phase type of the FIR filter, linear or minimum phase. The default is minimum phase.

afirsrc.ffmpeg: Generate a FIR coefficients audio stream.
afirsrc.what: Make the coefficients of a filter from frequency and gain points.

options.name: taps
options.what: The number of filter coefficients in the output audio stream, from 9 to 65535. The default is 1025.

options.name: frequency
options.what: The frequency points where magnitude and phase are set, separated by spaces. They must not decrease; the first is 0 and the last is 1.

options.name: magnitude
options.what: The magnitude at each frequency point, separated by spaces. There must be as many values as frequency points.

options.name: phase
options.what: The phase at each frequency point, separated by spaces. There must be as many values as frequency points.

options.name: sample_rate
options.what: The sample rate of the output. The default is 44100.

options.name: nb_samples
options.help: set the number of samples per requested frame
options.what: The number of samples in each frame. The default is 1024.

options.name: win_func
options.what: Which window function is applied. The default is blackman.

aformat.ffmpeg: Convert the input audio to one of the specified formats.
aformat.what: Force a sample format, rate or channel layout.

options.name: sample_fmts
options.what: A list of the requested sample formats, separated by |.

options.name: sample_rates
options.what: A list of the requested sample rates, separated by |.

options.name: channel_layouts
options.what: A list of the requested channel layouts, separated by |.

afreqshift.ffmpeg: Apply frequency shifting to input audio.
afreqshift.what: Move every frequency up or down by a fixed amount.

options.name: shift
options.what: How far the frequencies are shifted.

options.name: level
options.what: The gain applied to the final output, from 0 to 1.

options.name: order
options.what: The order of the filter used, from 1 to 16.

options.name: sigma
options.what: The strength of the denoising, from 0 to 1; it is easiest to set in decibels.

options.name: levels
options.what: The number of wavelet decomposition levels, from 1 to 12; too low a value makes denoising very poor.

options.name: wavet
options.what: The wavelet used to decompose each frame; they are sorted by number of coefficients, and more coefficients means better quality but slower speed.

options.name: percent
options.what: How much of the full denoising is applied, from 0 to 100 percent.

options.name: profile
options.what: Use the first input frame as the noise profile; if it holds more than noise, results are very poor.

options.name: adaptive
options.what: Analyse frames for noise and, when noise is detected, use that frame as the profile for the following frames.

options.name: samples
options.help: set frame size in number of samples
options.what: The size of a single frame in samples, from 512 to 65536.

options.name: softness
options.what: The softness applied inside the thresholding function, from 0 to 10.

agate.what: Silence the sound when it falls below a level.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The input level before filtering, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether lower parts are reduced (downward) or higher parts are amplified (upward).

options.name: range
options.what: The level of gain reduction when the signal is below the threshold, from 0 to 1; 0 disables the reduction.

options.name: threshold
options.what: The level above which the gain reduction is released, from 0 to 1.

options.name: ratio
options.what: The ratio by which the signal is reduced, from 1 to 9000.

options.name: attack
options.what: How many milliseconds the signal must stay above the threshold before gain reduction stops, from 0.01 to 9000.

options.name: release
options.what: How many milliseconds the signal must stay below the threshold before the reduction is increased again, from 0.01 to 9000.

options.name: makeup
options.what: How much the signal is amplified after processing, from 1 to 64.

options.name: knee
options.what: How softly the sharp bend around the threshold is curved, from 1 to 8.

options.name: detection
options.what: Whether the exact signal (peak) or an RMS-like level is used for detection.

options.name: link
options.what: Whether the average level of all channels or the louder channel affects the reduction.

options.name: level_sc
options.what: The gain applied to the sidechain signal, from 0.015625 to 64.

agraphmonitor.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song
agraphmonitor.plain: Show the audio filter graph's state
agraphmonitor.what: Draw how busy each step of the audio chain is.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the monitor picture. The default is hd720.

options.name: opacity
options.what: How opaque the monitor is drawn, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.9.

options.name: mode
options.what: Which display variations are used.

options.name: flags
options.what: Which pieces of information are shown for each filter. The default is all plus queue.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

ahistogram.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song
ahistogram.ffmpeg: Convert input audio to histogram video output.
ahistogram.what: Draw how the sound's level is distributed.

options.name: dmode
options.what: Whether one histogram is used for all channels or a separate one for each channel. The default is single.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. The default is hd720.

options.name: scale
options.what: The scale used to display the histogram. The default is logarithmic.

options.name: ascale
options.what: The scale used for amplitude. The default is logarithmic.

options.name: acount
options.what: How many frames are accumulated in the histogram, from -1 to 100. The default is 1, and -1 accumulates all frames.

options.name: rheight
options.help: set histogram ratio of window height
options.what: The share of the window height used by the histogram, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.1.

options.name: slide
options.what: How the sonogram moves on: old rows are replaced, or it scrolls from top to bottom. The default is replace.

options.name: hmode
options.what: Whether absolute sample values or untouched sample values are used. The default is abs.

aiir.ffmpeg: Apply Infinite Impulse Response filter with supplied coefficients.
aiir.what: Apply an infinite impulse response filter you give as numbers.

options.name: zeros
options.what: The B / numerator / zeros / reflection coefficients.

options.name: poles
options.what: The A / denominator / poles / ladder coefficients.

options.name: gains
options.what: The gain of each channel.

options.name: dry
options.what: The gain of the unfiltered signal, from 0 to 1.

options.name: wet
options.what: The gain of the filtered signal, from 0 to 1.

options.name: format
options.what: The format the coefficients are given in.

options.name: process
options.what: How the filter sections are processed.

options.name: precision
options.what: The number format used for filtering.

options.name: e
options.what: The number format used for filtering.

options.name: normalize
options.what: Normalise the filter coefficients, so the magnitude response at DC is 0 dB.

options.name: mix
options.what: How much of the filtered signal is used in the output, from 0 to 1.

options.name: response
options.what: Show the magnitude, phase and group delay of the filter in an additional video stream.

options.name: channel
options.help: set IR channel to display frequency response
options.what: Which channel's response is displayed; only used when the response is shown.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the response video; only used when the response is shown.

options.name: rate
options.what: The frame rate of the response video.

aintegral.what: Compute the running sum of the sound, a signal-processing tool.

ainterleave.what: Take a piece from each audio stream in turn.

options.name: nb_inputs
options.what: How many audio inputs are interleaved. At least 1.

options.name: duration
options.what: Which input decides when the output ends.

alatency.what: Report how long the sound waits in the filter chain.

alimiter.what: Stop the sound going above a level without hard clipping.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The input gain, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: level_out
options.what: The output gain, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: limit
options.what: The level above which signals are not allowed to pass, from 0.0625 to 1.

options.name: attack
options.what: How many milliseconds the limiter takes to reach its attenuation level, from 0.1 to 80.

options.name: release
options.what: How many milliseconds it takes to come back from limiting to no attenuation, from 1 to 8000.

options.name: asc
options.what: When gain reduction is always needed, release to an average reduction level instead of to no reduction.

options.name: asc_level
options.what: How much ASC affects the release time, from 0 to 1; 0 means nearly no change and 1 gives longer release times.

options.name: level
options.what: Automatically level the output signal, which normalises the audio back to 0 dB.

options.name: latency
options.what: Compensate the delay of the lookahead buffer, and flush the audio left in it when the stream ends.

allpass.what: Change the phase of the sound without changing its loudness.

options.name: frequency
options.what: The central frequency of the filter, in Hz.

options.name: width_type
options.what: The unit used to give the width of the filter.

options.name: width
options.what: The band-width of the filter, in the unit chosen as width type.

options.name: mix
options.what: How much of the filtered signal is used in the output, from 0 to 1.

options.name: channels
options.what: Which channels are filtered; by default all of them.

options.name: normalize
options.what: Normalise the filter coefficients, so the magnitude response at DC is 0 dB.

options.name: order
options.what: The order of the filter, 1 or 2.

options.name: transform
options.what: The form in which the filter is calculated.

options.name: precision
options.what: The sample format used for filtering.

allrgb.why: Pictures made out of nothing: test patterns, colour bars and generated art, with no video to apply them to
allrgb.what: A picture that holds every one of the 16.7 million RGB colours once.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

options.name: duration
options.what: How long the generated video lasts.

options.name: sar
options.what: The sample aspect ratio (the shape of a pixel) of the video. The default is 1/1.

allyuv.why: Pictures made out of nothing: test patterns, colour bars and generated art, with no video to apply them to
allyuv.what: A picture that holds every YUV colour once.

options.name: rate
options.what: The number of video frames per second. The default is 25.

options.name: duration
options.what: How long the generated video lasts.

options.name: sar
options.what: The sample aspect ratio (the shape of a pixel) of the video. The default is 1/1.

aloop.what: Repeat a section of the sound.

options.name: loop
options.what: How many times the section is repeated; -1 repeats it forever. The default is 0.

options.name: size
options.help: max number of samples to loop
options.what: The largest number of samples to loop. The default is 0.

options.name: start
options.what: The first sample of the loop; -1 means the start time is used instead. The default is 0.

options.name: time
options.what: The time in seconds where the loop starts; only used when the start sample is -1.

alphaextract.blocked: Needs a picture that has transparency.
alphaextract.ffmpeg: Extract an alpha channel as a grayscale image component.

alphamerge.what: The second video's brightness becomes the first one's transparency.
alphamerge.ffmpeg: Copy the luma value of the second input into the alpha channel of the first input.

amerge.ffmpeg: Merge two or more audio streams into a single multi-channel stream.
amerge.what: Combine several audio streams into one with all their channels.

options.name: inputs
options.what: How many audio streams are merged into one multi-channel stream, from 1 to 64. The default is 2.

options.name: layout_mode
options.help: method used to determine the output channel layout
options.what: How the layout of the merged channels is decided, and whether the channels are reordered during the merge.

ametadata.what: Read or write the data attached to each audio frame.

options.name: mode
options.what: What to do with the metadata of each audio frame: select frames, add, modify, delete or print metadata.

options.name: key
options.what: The name of the metadata entry to work on.

options.name: value
options.what: The value to set, or the value to compare against, for the chosen key.

options.name: function
options.what: How the value is compared with the frame's metadata when selecting frames.

options.name: expr
options.what: The expression used when the comparison is set to expression.

options.name: file
options.help: set file where to print metadata information
options.what: The file where the metadata is printed.

options.name: direct
options.help: reduce buffering when printing to user-set file or pipe
options.what: Reduces buffering when printing to a file or pipe you set. Off by default.

amix.what: Add several audio streams together into one.

options.name: inputs
options.what: How many audio streams are mixed into one. The default is 2.

options.name: duration
options.what: How the end of the mixed stream is decided.

options.name: dropout_transition

options.what: The time in seconds over which the volume is rebalanced when an input stream ends. The default is 2 seconds.

options.name: weights
options.what: How much each input counts, as numbers separated by spaces; the last weight is used for any remaining inputs. The default is 1 for each.

options.name: normalize
options.what: Always scale the inputs instead of only adding the samples together. Without it, heavy clipping is possible if the inputs are not already normalised. On by default.

amovie.ffmpeg: Read audio from a movie source.
amovie.what: Read the audio of another media file as the start of a chain.

options.name: filename
options.what: The file to read the audio from.

options.name: format_name
options.what: The container format of the file, if it should not be detected.

options.name: stream_index
options.what: Which stream of the file to read. The default is -1.

options.name: seek_point
options.what: Where in the file to start reading, in seconds. The default is 0.

options.name: streams
options.what: Which streams to read from the file.

options.name: loop
options.what: How many times the file is played. The default is 1.

options.name: discontinuity
options.what: The size of a timestamp jump that counts as a discontinuity.

options.name: dec_threads
options.help: set the number of threads for decoding
options.what: The number of threads used for decoding. The default is 0.

options.name: format_opts
options.help: set format options for the opened file
options.what: Extra options passed to the format when the file is opened.

amplify.what: Exaggerate what changes between frames.
amplify.ffmpeg: Amplify changes between successive video frames.

options.name: radius
options.what: How many neighbouring frames are used; a radius of 3 averages 7 frames. 1 to 63, default 2.

options.name: factor
options.what: How strongly the difference is amplified. 0 to 65535, default 2.

options.name: threshold
options.what: Any difference greater than or equal to this value leaves the source pixel unchanged. 0 to 65535, default 10.

options.name: tolerance
options.what: Any difference lower than this value leaves the source pixel unchanged. 0 to 65535, default 0.

options.name: low
options.what: The maximum value by which a source pixel can be decreased. 0 to 65535, default 65535.

options.name: high
options.what: The maximum value by which a source pixel can be increased. 0 to 65535, default 65535.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which colour planes are filtered. The default is all.

anequalizer.what: Many-band equaliser with its own curve per channel.

options.name: params
options.what: The bands in the form "cchn f=cf w=w g=g t=f", with each band separated by '|'. Type 0 is Butterworth (the default), 1 is Chebyshev type 1, 2 is Chebyshev type 2.

options.what: Shows the frequency response of the equalizer in the video stream. Off by default.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the video stream; only useful when curves are drawn. The default is hd720.

options.name: mgain
options.what: The largest gain that will be displayed, from -900 to 900. Only useful when curves are drawn. The default is 60.

options.name: fscale
options.what: The frequency scale used to draw the response in the video, linear or logarithmic. The default is logarithmic.

options.name: colors
options.what: The colour of each channel's curve, as colour names separated by a space or '|'. Unknown or missing colours become white.

options.name: patch

options.name: research

options.name: smooth
options.what: How smooth the result is, from 1 to 1000. The default is 11.

options.name: mu

options.name: eps

options.name: leakage
options.what: The leakage of the adaptive filter, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: out_mode
options.what: Which signal the filter outputs: the input, the desired signal, the output, the noise or the error.

options.name: precision
options.what: Which number precision is used when processing samples. The default is automatic.

anlms.ffmpeg: Apply Normalized Least-Mean-Squares algorithm to first audio stream.

options.name: order
options.what: The order of the adaptive filter, from 1 to 32767. The default is 256.

options.name: mu
options.what: The mu value of the adaptive filter, from 0 to 2. The default is 0.75.

options.name: eps
options.what: The eps value of the adaptive filter, from 0 to 1. The default is 1.

options.name: leakage
options.what: The leakage of the adaptive filter, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: out_mode
options.what: Which signal the filter outputs: the input, the desired signal, the output, the noise or the error.

options.name: precision

options.name: block_height

options.what: The size of the local patch, in two dimensions. 8 to 64, default 16.

options.name: bstep

options.name: group

options.name: range

options.name: mstep

options.name: thmse

options.name: hdthr

options.name: chroma_radius

options.name: alpha_radius

options.name: alpha_power

options.what: A file that gives the starting row; every non-whitespace character is a live cell and a newline ends the row.

options.what: The number of frames generated per second. The default is 25.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. If a file or pattern is given, the width follows the starting row.

options.name: rule

options.name: random_seed

options.what: The colour whose pixels get full transparency. Default black.

options.name: similarity
options.what: The radius around the key colour within which other colours also become fully transparent; a low value matches a very small radius and 1 matches everything. 0.01 to 1, default 0.01.

options.name: blend
options.help: set the colorkey key blend value
options.what: How the transparency of pixels outside the similarity radius is computed; at 0 they are either fully transparent or fully opaque, higher values give semi-transparent pixels. 0 to 1, default 0.

colorlevels.what: Set the black point and white point of each colour, as an image editor does.

options.name: rimin
options.what: The input black point for red. -1 to 1, default 0.

options.name: gimin
options.what: The input black point for green. -1 to 1, default 0.

options.name: bimin
options.what: The input black point for blue. -1 to 1, default 0.

options.name: aimin
options.what: The input black point for alpha. -1 to 1, default 0.

options.name: rimax
options.what: The input white point for red. -1 to 1, default 1.

options.name: gimax
options.what: The input white point for green. -1 to 1, default 1.

options.name: bimax
options.what: The input white point for blue. -1 to 1, default 1.

options.name: aimax
options.what: The input white point for alpha. -1 to 1, default 1.

options.name: romin
options.what: The output black point for red. 0 to 1, default 0.

options.name: gomin
options.what: The output black point for green. 0 to 1, default 0.

options.name: bomin
options.what: The output black point for blue. 0 to 1, default 0.

options.name: aomin
options.what: The output black point for alpha. 0 to 1, default 0.

options.name: romax
options.what: The output white point for red. 0 to 1, default 1.

options.name: gomax
options.what: The output white point for green. 0 to 1, default 1.

options.name: bomax
options.what: The output white point for blue. 0 to 1, default 1.

options.name: aomax
options.what: The output white point for alpha. 0 to 1, default 1.

options.name: preserve
options.what: Which value of the RGB triplet is preserved when levels are changed. The default is none, which disables it.

colormap.what: Replace colours with others given by two extra pictures.
colormap.ffmpeg: Apply custom Color Maps to video stream.

options.name: patch_size
options.what: The size of the colour patches in the source and target video streams, in pixels (default 64x64).

options.name: nb_patches
options.what: The most patches to use from the source and target streams, up to 64; by default all patches available are used.

options.name: type
options.what: Whether the target colours are read as relative adjustments or as absolute colours (default absolute).

options.name: kernel
options.help: set the kernel used for measuring color difference

choices.name: euclidean
choices.help: square root of sum of squared differences

choices.name: weuclidean
choices.help: weighted square root of sum of squared differences

options.what: How the difference between mapped colours is measured (default euclidean).

colormatrix.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
colormatrix.what: Convert between the Rec.601 and Rec.709 colour matrices.

options.name: src
options.what: The colour matrix of the input video. Both this and the destination must be given.

options.name: dst
options.what: The colour matrix the video is converted to. Both this and the source must be given.

colorspace.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
colorspace.what: Convert between colour spaces such as BT.601, BT.709 and BT.2020.

options.name: all
options.what: Sets the output colour space, primaries and transfer characteristics together in one go.

options.name: space
options.what: The colour space of the output video.

options.name: range
options.what: Whether the output uses the restricted (TV) range or the full (PC) range.

options.name: primaries
options.what: The colour primaries of the output video.

options.name: trc
options.what: The transfer characteristics of the output video.

options.name: format
options.what: The colour format of the output video.

options.name: fast
options.help: Ignore primary chromaticity and gamma correction
options.what: Skips the gamma and primary correction, which uses much less CPU but is mathematically incorrect. Turn it on to match the output of the colormatrix filter.

options.name: dither
options.what: The dithering mode used in the conversion.

options.name: wpadapt
options.what: The method used to adapt the white point.

options.name: clipgamut
options.help: Controls how to clip out-of-gamut colors that arise as a result of colorspace conversion.
options.what: How colours that fall outside the allowed range after the conversion are clipped.

options.name: iall
options.help: Set all input color properties together
options.what: Overrides the input colour space, primaries and transfer characteristics together, with the same values as for the output.

options.name: ispace
options.what: Overrides the colour space of the input, with the same values as for the output.

options.name: irange
options.what: Overrides the colour range of the input, with the same values as for the output.

options.name: iprimaries
options.what: Overrides the colour primaries of the input, with the same values as for the output.

options.name: itrc
options.what: Overrides the transfer characteristics of the input, with the same values as for the output.

options.name: range
options.what: The colour range of the output video, full (PC or JPEG) or limited (TV or MPEG).

colorspectrum.why: Pictures made out of nothing: test patterns, colour bars and generated art, with no video to apply them to
colorspectrum.what: A picture showing a spectrum of colours.

options.name: size
options.what: The width and height of the generated video. The default is 320x240.

options.name: rate
options.what: How many frames per second the video has. The default is 25.

options.name: duration
options.what: How long the generated video lasts. A negative value (the default) means it goes on forever.

options.name: sar
options.what: The sample aspect ratio, which is the shape of each pixel, as a fraction. The default is 1/1.

options.name: type
options.what: Which colour spectrum is drawn. The default fades to black.

colortemperature.what: Make the picture warmer (orange) or cooler (blue).

options.name: temperature
options.what: The colour temperature to simulate, from 1000 to 40000. 6500 is the default.

options.name: mix
options.help: set the mix with filtered output
options.what: How much of the adjusted picture is mixed with the original, from 0 to 1.

options.name: pl
options.help: set the amount of preserving lightness
options.what: How much of the picture's lightness is preserved, from 0 to 1.

compand.ffmpeg: Compress or expand audio dynamic range.
compand.what: Compress or expand the dynamics with a transfer curve you set.

options.name: attacks
options.help: set time over which increase of volume is determined
options.what: A list of times in seconds, one per channel, over which the level is averaged when the sound gets louder. A typical value is 0.3 seconds, and it should be shorter than the decay time.

options.name: decays
options.help: set time over which decrease of volume is determined
options.what: A list of times in seconds, one per channel, over which the level is averaged when the sound gets quieter. A typical value is 0.8 seconds.

options.name: points
options.what: The points of the transfer function in dB relative to the maximum signal, written as x0/y0|x1/y1|... in strictly increasing input order. A typical value is -70/-70|-60/-20|1/0.

options.name: soft-knee
options.what: The curve radius in dB for all joints of the transfer function, from 0.01 to 900. The default is 0.01.

options.name: gain
options.what: Additional gain in dB applied at all points on the transfer function, for easy adjustment of the overall level. The default is 0.

options.name: volume
options.what: The volume in dB assumed for each channel when filtering starts, so that a very large gain is not applied before the effect has begun to work. A typical value for initially quiet audio is -90 dB.

options.name: delay
options.help: set delay for samples before sending them to volume adjuster
options.what: A delay in seconds, from 0 to 20, before the audio reaches the volume adjuster, so the filter can act predictively. The default is 0.

compensationdelay.what: Delay the sound as if it travelled a distance, to line up speakers.

options.name: mm
options.what: The compensation distance for fine tuning, from 0 to 10 millimetres. The default is 0.

options.name: cm
options.what: The compensation distance for tightening the setup, from 0 to 100 centimetres. The default is 0.

options.name: m
options.what: The compensation distance for the coarse setup, from 0 to 100 metres. The default is 0.

options.name: dry
options.what: The amount of unprocessed (dry) signal, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: wet
options.what: The amount of processed (wet) signal, from 0 to 1. The default is 1.

options.name: temp
options.what: The temperature of the environment in degrees Celsius, from -50 to 50. The default is 20.

concat.what: Play several videos and sounds one after the other.

options.name: n
options.what: How many segments are joined one after the other. The default is 2.

options.name: v
options.help: specify the number of video streams
options.what: The number of video streams in the output, which is also the number in each segment. The default is 1.

options.name: a
options.help: specify the number of audio streams
options.what: The number of audio streams in the output, which is also the number in each segment. The default is 0.

options.name: unsafe
options.what: Do not fail when the segments have a different format.

convolution.what: Apply a matrix of numbers you give (blur, emboss, sharpen).

options.name: 0m
options.what: The matrix for the first plane: 9, 25 or 49 signed integers in square mode, or an odd number from 1 to 49 in row mode.

options.name: 1m
options.what: The matrix for the second plane: 9, 25 or 49 signed integers in square mode, or an odd number from 1 to 49 in row mode.

options.name: 2m
options.what: The matrix for the third plane: 9, 25 or 49 signed integers in square mode, or an odd number from 1 to 49 in row mode.

options.name: 3m
options.what: The matrix for the fourth plane: 9, 25 or 49 signed integers in square mode, or an odd number from 1 to 49 in row mode.

options.name: 0rdiv
options.what: The multiplier for the calculated value of the first plane. If unset or 0, it is 1 divided by the sum of all matrix elements.

options.name: 1rdiv
options.what: The multiplier for the calculated value of the second plane. If unset or 0, it is 1 divided by the sum of all matrix elements.

options.name: 2rdiv
options.what: The multiplier for the calculated value of the third plane. If unset or 0, it is 1 divided by the sum of all matrix elements.

options.name: 3rdiv
options.what: The multiplier for the calculated value of the fourth plane. If unset or 0, it is 1 divided by the sum of all matrix elements.

options.name: 0bias
options.what: A value added to the result for the first plane, useful for making the image brighter or darker. Default 0.

options.name: 1bias
options.what: A value added to the result for the second plane, useful for making the image brighter or darker. Default 0.

options.name: 2bias
options.what: A value added to the result for the third plane, useful for making the image brighter or darker. Default 0.

options.name: 3bias
options.what: A value added to the result for the fourth plane, useful for making the image brighter or darker. Default 0.

options.name: 0mode
options.what: Whether the matrix for the first plane is square, a single row or a single column. The default is square.

options.name: 1mode
options.what: Whether the matrix for the second plane is square, a single row or a single column. The default is square.

options.name: 2mode
options.what: Whether the matrix for the third plane is square, a single row or a single column. The default is square.

options.name: 3mode
options.what: Whether the matrix for the fourth plane is square, a single row or a single column. The default is square.

convolve.what: Spread each pixel by a kernel given as a second video.
convolve.ffmpeg: Convolve first video stream with second video stream.

options.name: planes
options.what: A bitmap of which colour planes to process, from 0 to 15 (default 7).

options.name: impulse

choices.name: first
choices.help: process only first impulse, ignore rest

options.what: Whether only the first frame of the second stream is used as the impulse, or every frame (default all).

options.name: noise
options.what: A small noise value used in the calculation, from 0 to 1 (default 1e-7).

copy.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
copy.ffmpeg: Copy the input video unchanged to the output.
copy.what: Pass the picture on without any change.

corr.why: Measurements between two videos: they compare, they do not change the picture
corr.ffmpeg: Calculate the correlation between two video streams.
corr.what: Score how alike two videos are with a correlation number.

cover_rect.blocked: Needs a picture of the object to look for.
cover_rect.ffmpeg: Find and cover a user specified object.

options.name: cover
options.what: The path of the optional cover image, which needs to be in yuv420.

options.name: mode
options.what: How the area is covered: with the supplied image, or by interpolating the surrounding pixels. The default is blur.

crop.what: Cut a strip off any edge of the picture.

options.name: out_w
options.help: set the width crop area expression
options.what: The width of the cropped picture, as a number or an expression. By default the full width.

options.name: out_h
options.help: set the height crop area expression
options.what: The height of the cropped picture, as a number or an expression. By default the full height.

options.name: x
options.help: set the x crop area expression
options.what: Where the cropped area starts, counted from the left, as a number or an expression. By default it is centred.

options.name: y
options.help: set the y crop area expression
options.what: Where the cropped area starts, counted from the top, as a number or an expression. By default it is centred.

options.name: keep_aspect
options.what: Keep the display shape of the input by changing the shape of its pixels.

options.name: exact
options.what: Crop at exactly the given size and place, without rounding down for subsampled video.

cropdetect.why: Measurements and diagnostics: they report on the picture, they do not change it
cropdetect.what: Work out how much to crop to remove the black bars.

options.name: limit
options.help: Threshold below which the pixel is considered black
options.what: The brightness above which a pixel counts as non-black, from 0 (nothing) to 255 (everything) for 8-bit formats, or a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

options.name: round
options.help: Value by which the width/height should be divisible
options.plain: Round size to a multiple of
options.what: The value the width and height of the detected area must be divisible by. The default is 16.

options.name: reset
options.help: Recalculate the crop area after this many frames

options.name: skip
options.help: Number of initial frames to skip
options.plain: Frames to skip at the start
options.what: How many of the first frames are not evaluated. The default is 2.

options.name: reset_count
options.help: Recalculate the crop area after this many frames
options.what: After this many frames the detected area is forgotten and detection starts over, which helps when channel logos distort the area. 0 means never.

options.name: max_outliers
options.what: The threshold count of outliers allowed in the detection. The default is 0.

options.name: mode

choices.name: black
choices.help: detect black pixels surrounding the video

choices.name: mvedges
choices.help: detect motion and edged surrounding the video

options.what: Whether the playing area is found from the black pixels around it or from motion vectors and edge pixels.

options.name: high
options.help: Set high threshold for edge detection
options.what: The high threshold of the Canny edge detection, which picks the strong edge pixels. From 0 to 1.

options.name: low
options.help: Set low threshold for edge detection
options.what: The low threshold of the Canny edge detection, which picks the weak edge pixels. From 0 to 1.

options.name: mv_threshold
options.help: motion vector threshold when estimating video window size
options.what: The motion, in pixels, above which movement is detected when estimating the video window. The default is 8.

crossfeed.what: Mix a little of each side into the other to ease headphone listening.

options.name: strength
options.what: How strongly the channels are blended, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.2.

options.name: range
options.what: The soundstage wideness, from 0 to 1, which sets the cut-off frequency of the low shelf filter. The default is 0.5.

options.name: slope
options.what: The slope of the low shelf filter curve, from 0.01 to 1. The default is 0.5.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The gain applied to the incoming sound, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.9.

options.name: level_out
options.what: The gain applied to the finished sound, from 0 to 1. The default is 1.

options.name: block_size
options.what: The block size, in samples, used for reverse IIR processing; when non-zero the filter delay is exactly this many samples. The default is 0.

crystalizer.what: Sharpen the sound by exaggerating its changes.

options.name: i
options.what: How strong the effect is, from -10 to 10. The default is 2; 0 leaves the sound unchanged and a negative value reverses the filtering.

options.name: c
options.what: Whether clipping is enabled. It is on by default.

cue.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
cue.ffmpeg: Delay filtering to match a cue.
cue.what: Hold the video until a wall-clock time.

options.name: cue
options.what: The moment to wait for, as a UNIX timestamp in microseconds. The default is 0.

options.name: preroll
options.what: How much content is passed on before waiting for the cue, in seconds. The default is 0.

options.name: buffer
options.what: The most content that is held back while waiting for the cue, in seconds. The default is 0.

curves.what: Reshape the tones with a curve, as in a photo editor.

options.name: preset
options.what: One of the available colour presets; the r, g and b options take priority over its values. The default is none.

options.name: master
options.what: The key points of the master curve, a second pass mapping sometimes called a luminance or value mapping.

options.name: red
options.what: The key points for the red component.

options.name: green
options.what: The key points for the green component.

options.name: blue
options.what: The key points for the blue component.

options.name: all
options.help: set points coordinates for all components
options.what: The key points for all components except the master; any component left unset falls back on this.

options.name: psfile
options.what: The path of a Photoshop curves file (.acv) to import the settings from.

options.name: plot
options.help: save Gnuplot script of the curves in specified file
options.what: The file in which a Gnuplot script of the curves is saved.

options.name: interp
options.what: The kind of interpolation used between the key points. The default is natural.

datascope.why: Measurements and diagnostics: they report on the picture, they do not change it
datascope.what: Print the numeric values of the pixels of an area.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. The default is hd720.

options.name: x
options.what: The x position from which pixels are picked.

options.name: y
options.what: The y position from which pixels are picked.

options.name: mode
options.what: How the hexadecimal pixel values are drawn.

options.name: axis
options.what: Draws the numbers of the rows and columns on the left and top of the video.

options.name: opacity
options.what: How opaque the background is, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.75.

options.name: format
options.what: Whether the values are shown in hexadecimal or decimal. The default is hex.

options.name: components
options.what: Which pixel components are displayed, from 1 to 15. By default all of them are.

dblur.what: Blur in one direction: a motion streak.

options.name: angle
options.what: The angle of the directional blur. 0 to 360, default 45.

options.name: radius
options.what: The radius of the directional blur. 0 to 8192, default 5.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which planes are filtered. By default all planes are filtered.

dcshift.ffmpeg: Apply a DC shift to the audio.
dcshift.what: Move the whole waveform up or down.

options.name: shift
options.what: The amount to shift the audio by, from -1 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: limitergain
options.what: An optional value, much less than 1, that is used to prevent clipping.

options.name: sigma
options.what: The noise sigma constant, which sets a hard threshold of 3 times sigma below which DCT coefficients are dropped. 0 to 999, default 0.

options.name: overlap
options.help: set number of block overlapping pixels
options.what: The number of overlapping pixels for each block; lowering it is faster but less effective. -1 to 15, default is the block size minus one.

options.name: expr
options.what: An expression evaluated as a multiplier for each coefficient of a DCT block, with the coefficient's absolute value in the variable c. If set, sigma is ignored.

options.name: n
options.help: set the block size, expressed in bits
options.what: The block size as a number of bits: 1<<n is the width and height of the blocks. 3 (8x8) to 4 (16x16), default 3.

ddagrab.why: Inputs and outputs of a filter graph: not effects
ddagrab.ffmpeg: Grab Windows Desktop images using Desktop Duplication API
ddagrab.what: Capture the desktop of a Windows machine as video.

options.name: output_idx
options.what: The number of the screen to capture, starting at 0. It usually matches the number Windows gives the screen minus one.

options.name: draw_mouse
options.what: Whether to draw the mouse cursor. It only affects hardware cursors; a cursor drawn by a game or application is always captured.

options.name: framerate
options.what: The most frames per second captured; the gap between frames is never smaller than this. The default is 30.

options.name: video_size
options.what: The size of the captured video, cropped from the bottom and right if smaller than the screen. By default it is the full screen.

options.name: offset_x
options.what: The horizontal offset of the captured area.

options.name: offset_y
options.what: The vertical offset of the captured area.

options.name: output_fmt

choices.name: auto
choices.help: let dda pick its preferred format

options.what: The pixel format of the captured frames. The default is 8-bit BGRA.

options.name: allow_fallback
options.help: don't error on fallback to default 8 Bit format
options.what: Do not fail when the requested format is unavailable and the default 8-bit format is used instead.

options.name: force_fmt
options.help: exclude BGRA from format list (experimental, discouraged by Microsoft)
options.what: Excludes BGRA from the list of formats. This is experimental and discouraged by Microsoft.

options.name: dup_frames
options.plain: Repeat frames to keep the rate
options.what: Repeats frames when the desktop has not changed, to keep a steady frame rate. The default is on.

deband.what: Smooth the visible steps in skies and gradients.

options.name: 1thr
options.what: How different a pixel may be from its reference and still count as banded, for the first plane. 0.00003 to 0.5.

options.name: 2thr
options.what: The same for the second plane.

options.name: 3thr
options.what: The same for the third plane.

options.name: 4thr
options.what: The same for the fourth plane.

options.name: range
options.what: How far, in pixels, to look for reference pixels. A positive value picks a random distance up to it, a negative value uses exactly that distance.

options.name: direction
options.what: The direction in which reference pixels are looked for, in radians.

options.name: blur
options.what: Compare each pixel with the average of its four neighbours. When off, it is compared with each of the four.

options.name: coupling
options.what: Change a pixel only if every colour component of it is banded.

deblock.what: Soften the squares an over-compressed video shows.

options.name: filter
options.what: What kind of deblocking is applied, weak or strong. The default is strong.

options.name: block
options.what: The size of the block. 4 to 512, default 8.

options.name: alpha
options.what: The blocking detection threshold at the exact edge of a block; higher values give more deblocking strength. 0 to 1, default 0.098.

options.name: beta
options.what: A blocking detection threshold near the edge of a block; higher values give more deblocking strength. 0 to 1, default 0.05.

options.name: gamma
options.what: A blocking detection threshold near the edge of a block; higher values give more deblocking strength. 0 to 1, default 0.05.

options.name: delta
options.what: A blocking detection threshold near the edge of a block; higher values give more deblocking strength. 0 to 1, default 0.05.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which planes are filtered. The default is all available planes.

decimate.what: Remove frames that repeat the one before, for video that was stretched from a lower frame rate.

options.name: cycle
options.help: set the number of frame from which one will be dropped
options.what: The number of frames in each batch from which one frame is dropped. 2 to 25, default 5.

options.name: dupthresh
options.what: A frame whose difference metric is less than or equal to this value is declared a duplicate. 0 to 100, default 1.1.

options.name: scthresh
options.what: The threshold for detecting a scene change. 0 to 100, default 15.

options.name: blockx
options.help: set the size of the x-axis blocks used during metric calculations
options.what: The size of the x-axis blocks used in the metric calculations; larger blocks suppress noise better but detect small movements worse. A power of two, 4 to 512, default 32.

options.name: blocky
options.help: set the size of the y-axis blocks used during metric calculations
options.what: The size of the y-axis blocks used in the metric calculations; larger blocks suppress noise better but detect small movements worse. A power of two, 4 to 512, default 32.

options.name: ppsrc
options.help: mark main input as a pre-processed input and activate clean source input stream
options.what: Marks the main input as pre-processed and activates a second, clean source input from which the kept frames are chosen. Off by default.

options.name: chroma
options.help: set whether or not chroma is considered in the metric calculations
options.what: Whether colour is considered in the metric calculations. On by default.

options.name: mixed
options.help: set whether or not the input only partially contains content to be decimated
options.what: Whether the input only partially contains content to be decimated; if on, the output has a variable frame rate. Off by default.

deconvolve.what: The reverse of convolve: sharpen away a known blur.
deconvolve.ffmpeg: Deconvolve first video stream with second video stream.

options.name: planes
options.what: A bitmap of which colour planes to process, from 0 to 15 (default 7).

options.name: impulse

choices.name: first
choices.help: process only first impulse, ignore rest

options.what: Whether only the first frame of the second stream is used as the impulse, or every frame (default all).

options.name: noise
options.what: Noise added when doing divisions, from 0 to 1 (default 0.0000001); useful when width and height differ and are not powers of 2, or when the stream had noise before convolving.

dedot.what: Clean the dots and rainbows of old analogue video.

options.name: m
options.what: Which problem is reduced: dot crawl (cross-luminance), rainbows (cross-color) or both. Both by default.

options.name: lt
options.what: The spatial luma threshold; lower values increase the reduction of cross-luminance. 0 to 1, default 0.079.

options.name: tl
options.what: The tolerance for temporal luma; higher values increase the reduction of cross-luminance. 0 to 1, default 0.079.

options.name: tc
options.help: set tolerance for chroma temporal variation
options.what: The tolerance for chroma temporal variation; higher values increase the reduction of cross-color. 0 to 1, default 0.058.

options.name: ct
options.what: The temporal chroma threshold; lower values increase the reduction of cross-color. 0 to 1, default 0.019.

deesser.what: Soften harsh s sounds in speech.

options.name: i
options.what: How easily de-essing is triggered, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: m
options.what: The amount of ducking on the treble part of the sound, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.5.

options.name: f
options.what: How much of the original frequency content is kept when de-essing, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.5.

options.name: s
options.what: Which part of the sound is passed on: the input unchanged, the sound with the ess removed, or only the ess.

deflate.what: Make bright areas smaller (a morphological effect).

options.name: threshold0
options.what: Limits the maximum change for the first plane. 0 to 65535, default 65535; at 0 the plane stays unchanged.

options.name: threshold1
