options.what: The largest change allowed for the third plane, from 0 to 65535. At 0 the plane stays unchanged.

options.name: threshold3
options.what: The largest change allowed for the fourth plane, from 0 to 65535. At 0 the plane stays unchanged.

options.name: mode

choices.name: frame
choices.help: send one frame for each frame

choices.name: field
choices.help: send one frame for each field

options.what: Whether one frame is output for each frame or for each field. The default is one per field.

options.name: parity
options.help: specify the assumed picture field parity
options.what: Which field of the interlaced input comes first. Automatic detection is the default; if the order is unknown, top field first is assumed.

options.name: deint

choices.name: interlaced
choices.help: only deinterlace frames marked as interlaced

options.what: Whether all frames are deinterlaced or only those marked as interlaced. The default is all.

options.name: rslope
options.help: specify the search radius for edge slope tracing
options.what: The search radius for edge slope tracing, from 1 to 15. The default is 1.

options.name: redge
options.help: specify the search radius for best edge matching
options.what: The search radius for best edge matching, from 0 to 15. The default is 2.

options.name: ecost
options.help: specify the edge cost for edge matching
options.what: The edge cost used for edge matching, from 0 to 50. The default is 2.

options.name: mcost
options.help: specify the middle cost for edge matching
options.what: The middle cost used for edge matching, from 0 to 50. The default is 1.

options.name: dcost
options.help: specify the distance cost for edge matching
options.what: The distance cost used for edge matching, from 0 to 50. The default is 1.

options.name: interp
options.what: The interpolation used to fill in the missing lines. The default is four-point.

exposure.what: Make the whole picture lighter or darker, like a camera's exposure.
exposure.ffmpeg: Adjust exposure of the video stream.

options.name: exposure
options.what: How much lighter or darker the picture is made, from -3 to 3 EV.

options.name: black
options.what: Correct the black level, from -1 to 1.

extractplanes.blocked: Gives one picture per channel: the app would need to choose which one to keep.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which colour channels are pulled out as separate grayscale streams. Channels the input does not have cause an error, so RGB and YUV channels cannot be mixed.

extrastereo.ffmpeg: Increase difference between stereo audio channels.
extrastereo.what: Increase the difference between left and right.

options.name: m
options.what: How much the difference between the channels is increased, from -10 to 10. The default is 2.5; 0 gives mono, 1 leaves the sound unchanged and -1 swaps left and right.

options.name: c
options.what: Whether clipping is enabled. It is on by default.

fade.what: Fade from or to black (or a colour) at a chosen time.

options.name: type
options.what: Whether the picture fades in or fades out. The default is in.

options.name: start_frame
options.help: Number of the first frame to which to apply the effect.
options.what: The number of the frame where the fade starts. The default is 0.

options.name: nb_frames
options.help: Number of frames to which the effect should be applied.
options.what: How many frames the fade lasts. A fade-in ends with the original picture; a fade-out ends filled with the chosen colour. The default is 25.

options.name: alpha
options.help: fade alpha if it is available on the input
options.what: Fades only the transparency channel, if the input has one.

options.name: start_time
options.help: Number of seconds of the beginning of the effect.
options.what: The time in seconds where the fade starts. If a start frame is also given, the fade starts at whichever comes last. The default is 0.

options.name: duration
options.help: Duration of the effect in seconds.
options.what: How many seconds the fade lasts. If this and the length in frames are both given, this one is used. The default is 0, which uses the length in frames.

options.name: color
options.what: The colour the picture fades to or from. The default is black.

feedback.what: Feed a part of the output back into the input: a video-mirror-in-mirror look.

options.name: x
options.what: The horizontal position of the top left corner of the cropped area.

options.name: y
options.what: The vertical position of the top left corner of the cropped area.

options.name: w
options.what: The width of the cropped area.

options.name: h
options.what: The height of the cropped area.

fftdnoiz.what: A frequency-based denoiser working over time. Slow.

options.name: sigma
options.what: The noise constant, which sets how strongly noise is removed, from 0 to 100. The default is 1; very high values with low overlap may give blocky artifacts.

options.name: amount
options.what: How much of the detected noise is removed, from 0.01 to 1. The default is 1, which removes all of it.

options.name: block
options.what: The size of the blocks the picture is processed in, from 8 to 256 pixels. The default is 32.

options.name: overlap
options.what: How much the blocks overlap, from 0.2 to 0.8. The default is 0.5.

options.name: method
options.what: The method used to remove noise. The default is wiener.

options.name: prev
options.help: set number of previous frames for temporal denoising
options.what: How many previous frames are used to help the denoising, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: next
options.help: set number of next frames for temporal denoising
options.what: How many following frames are used to help the denoising, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which colour planes are filtered, as a combined number from 0 to 15. The default of 7 filters all but transparency.

options.name: window
options.what: The window function used for the blocks. The default is hann.

fftfilt.what: Edit the picture's frequencies with expressions.
fftfilt.ffmpeg: Apply arbitrary expressions to pixels in frequency domain.

options.name: dc_Y
options.what: The DC value (gain) of the brightness plane, from 0 to 1000. The default is 0.

options.name: dc_U
options.what: The DC value (gain) of the first colour plane, from 0 to 1000. The default is 0.

options.name: dc_V
options.what: The DC value (gain) of the second colour plane, from 0 to 1000. The default is 0.

options.name: weight_Y
options.help: set luminance expression in Y plane
options.what: The frequency-domain weight expression for the brightness plane. The default is 1.

options.name: weight_U
options.help: set chrominance expression in U plane
options.what: The frequency-domain weight expression for the first colour plane.

options.name: weight_V
options.help: set chrominance expression in V plane
options.what: The frequency-domain weight expression for the second colour plane.

options.name: eval
options.what: When the expressions are evaluated: once at start, or for every incoming frame. The default is once.

field.what: Keep only the top or bottom field.
field.ffmpeg: Extract a field from the input video.

options.name: type
options.what: Whether the top or the bottom field is extracted from the interlaced picture. The default is top.

fieldhint.what: Match fields using a hints file.

options.name: hint
options.what: A file with one line per frame telling which frames to take the top and bottom fields from. Each line holds two numbers separated by a comma.

options.name: mode
options.what: How the numbers in the hint file are read: absolute or relative frame numbers, or pattern, which is like relative but restarts from the start of the file when frames remain. The default is absolute.

fieldmatch.what: Rebuild the original film frames of a movie that was converted to 29.97 interlaced video.

options.name: order
options.what: The assumed field order of the input stream. The default is to detect it automatically.

options.name: mode
options.help: set the matching mode or strategy to use

choices.name: pc_u
choices.help: 2-way match + 3rd match (same order) on combed (p/c + u)

choices.name: pc_n_ub
choices.help: 2-way match + 3rd match on combed + 4th/5th matches if still combed (p/c + u + u/b)

options.what: How hard the filter tries to find a matching field. The pc mode is the safest against jerkiness and pcn_ub the riskiest but finds a good match most often. The default is pc_n.

options.name: ppsrc
options.help: mark main input as a pre-processed input and activate clean source input stream
options.what: Marks the main input as pre-processed and uses the second input as the clean source to pick fields from. Off by default.

options.name: field
options.help: set the field to match from
options.what: The field the matching starts from. The default is automatic.

options.name: mchroma
options.help: set whether or not chroma is included during the match comparisons
options.what: Whether colour is included in the match comparisons. It is on by default; turning it off helps with clips that have heavy colour artifacts and can speed things up.

options.name: y0
options.help: define an exclusion band which excludes the lines between y0 and y1 from the field matching decision
options.what: The first scan line of a band that is left out of the field matching decision, useful for subtitles or a logo. The default is 0.

options.name: y1
options.help: define an exclusion band which excludes the lines between y0 and y1 from the field matching decision
options.what: The last scan line of a band that is left out of the field matching decision. If this equals the start line, the feature is off. The default is 0.

options.name: scthresh
options.what: The scene change detection threshold as a percentage of the maximum brightness change, from 0.0 to 100.0. The default is 12.0.

options.name: combmatch

choices.name: sc
choices.help: enable combmatching only on scene change

options.what: When the combed scores of matches are used to pick the final match. The default is on scene change only.

options.name: combdbg
options.what: Forces the combed scores to be calculated and printed for certain matches. The default is none.

options.name: cthresh
options.help: set the area combing threshold used for combed frame detection
options.what: How visible combing must be to be detected, from -1 (every pixel counts as combed) to 255 (none does). The default is 9.

options.name: chroma
options.help: set whether or not chroma is considered in the combed frame decision
options.what: Whether colour is considered when deciding if a frame is combed. Off by default; only turn it on if combing shows in colour alone.

options.name: blockx
options.help: set the x-axis size of the window used during combed frame detection
options.what: The width of the window used to detect combed frames, a power of 2 from 4 to 512. The default is 16.

options.name: blocky
options.help: set the y-axis size of the window used during combed frame detection
options.what: The height of the window used to detect combed frames, a power of 2 from 4 to 512. The default is 16.

options.name: combpel
options.help: set the number of combed pixels inside any of the blocky by blockx size blocks on the frame for the frame to be detected as combed
options.what: How many combed pixels any one window must hold for the frame to count as combed. The default is 80.

options.name: order
options.what: Which field comes first in the output: top field first or bottom field first. The default is top first.

fillborders.what: Fill the edges of the picture, for example after stabilising.
fillborders.ffmpeg: Fill borders of the input video.

options.name: left
options.what: The number of pixels to fill from the left edge. The default is 0.

options.name: right
options.what: The number of pixels to fill from the right edge. The default is 0.

options.name: top
options.what: The number of pixels to fill from the top edge. The default is 0.

options.name: bottom
options.what: The number of pixels to fill from the bottom edge. The default is 0.

options.name: mode
options.what: How the border pixels are filled. The default is smear.

options.name: color
options.help: set the color for the fixed/fade mode
options.what: The colour used by the fixed and fade methods. The default is black.

find_rect.why: Measurements and diagnostics: they report on the picture, they do not change it
find_rect.what: Look for a shape you gave as a picture and report where it is.

options.name: object
options.what: The file of the image to look for. It must be in gray8 format.

options.name: threshold
options.what: How close a match must be, from 0 to 1. 0.01 means only exact matches and 0.99 means almost everything matches. The default is 0.5.

options.name: mipmaps
options.what: The number of mipmaps used in the search, from 1 to 5. The default is 3.

options.name: xmin
options.what: The left edge of the rectangle in which to search.

options.name: ymin
options.what: The top edge of the rectangle in which to search.

options.name: xmax
options.what: The right edge of the rectangle in which to search.

options.name: ymax
options.what: The bottom edge of the rectangle in which to search.

options.name: discard
options.what: Discards the frames in which the object is not found. The default is off.

firequalizer.what: A precise equaliser with a curve you describe.

options.name: gain
options.what: The gain curve as an equation, in dB. The default is gain_interpolate(f).

options.name: gain_entry
options.what: The gain entries used by the gain_interpolate function.

options.name: delay
options.what: The filter delay in seconds, where a higher value means more accurate. The default is 0.01.

options.name: accuracy
options.what: The filter accuracy in Hz, where a lower value means more accurate. The default is 5.

options.name: wfunc
options.what: The window function used. The default is hann.

options.name: fixed
options.what: Whether a fixed number of audio samples is used, which improves speed with a large delay. It is off by default.

options.name: multi
options.what: Whether the gain is evaluated for multiple channels. It is off by default.

options.name: zero_phase
options.what: Whether zero phase mode is used, subtracting the timestamp to compensate the delay. It is off by default.

options.name: scale
options.what: The scale used by the gain. The default is linlog.

options.name: dumpfile
options.what: A file to dump the curve to, suitable for gnuplot.

options.name: dumpscale
options.what: The scale used for the dump file. The default is linlog.

options.name: fft2
options.what: Whether 2-channel convolution using complex FFT is used, which improves speed significantly. It is off by default.

options.name: min_phase
options.what: Whether a minimum phase impulse response is used. It is off by default.

flanger.ffmpeg: Apply a flanging effect to the audio.
flanger.what: Add a sweeping, jet-like effect.

options.name: delay
options.what: The base delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 30. The default is 0.

options.name: depth
options.what: The added swept delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 10. The default is 2.

options.name: regen
options.what: The percentage of regeneration (delayed signal fed back), from -95 to 95. The default is 0.

options.name: width
options.help: percentage of delayed signal mixed with original
options.what: The percentage of delayed signal mixed with the original, from 0 to 100. The default is 71.

options.name: speed
options.what: The number of sweeps per second, from 0.1 to 10. The default is 0.5.

options.name: shape
options.what: The shape of the swept wave, triangular or sinusoidal. The default is sinusoidal.

options.name: phase
options.help: swept wave percentage phase-shift for multi-channel
options.what: The percentage phase shift of the swept wave between channels, from 0 to 100. The default is 25.

options.name: interp
options.what: The delay-line interpolation, linear or quadratic. The default is linear.

floodfill.what: Fill a region of one colour with another.
floodfill.ffmpeg: Fill area with same color with another color.

options.name: x
options.what: The x coordinate of the pixel where the fill starts.

options.name: y
options.what: The y coordinate of the pixel where the fill starts.

options.name: s0
options.what: The value of component 0 that pixels must have to be filled; -1 is also allowed.

options.name: s1
options.what: The value of component 1 that pixels must have to be filled; -1 is also allowed.

options.name: s2
options.what: The value of component 2 that pixels must have to be filled; -1 is also allowed.

options.name: s3
options.what: The value of component 3 that pixels must have to be filled; -1 is also allowed.

options.name: d0
options.what: The value component 0 is given in the filled area.

options.name: d1
options.what: The value component 1 is given in the filled area.

options.name: d2
options.what: The value component 2 is given in the filled area.

options.name: d3
options.what: The value component 3 is given in the filled area.

format.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
format.ffmpeg: Convert the input video to one of the specified pixel formats.

options.name: pix_fmts
options.what: A list of pixel format names separated by |, such as yuv420p|monow|rgb24.

options.name: color_spaces
options.what: A list of colour space names separated by |, such as bt709|bt470bg|bt2020nc.

options.name: color_ranges
options.what: A list of colour range names separated by |, such as tv|pc.

options.name: alpha_modes
options.what: A list of alpha mode names separated by |, such as straight|premultiplied.

fps.what: Force a constant number of pictures per second.

options.name: fps
options.help: A string describing desired output framerate
options.what: The frame rate of the result.

options.name: start_time
options.help: Assume the first PTS should be this value.
options.what: Assume the first frame starts at this time, in seconds. This allows padding or trimming at the start. By default nothing is padded or trimmed.

options.name: round
options.what: How timestamps are rounded to the new frame rate.

options.name: eof_action

choices.name: round
choices.plain: Use same timestamp rounding method as used for other frames

choices.name: pass
choices.plain: Pass through last frame if input duration has not been reached yet

options.what: What to do with the last frame.

framepack.what: Build a frame-packed stereoscopic video from a left and a right view.
framepack.ffmpeg: Generate a frame packed stereoscopic video.

options.name: format

choices.name: sbs
choices.help: Views are packed next to each other

choices.name: tab
choices.help: Views are packed on top of each other

choices.name: frameseq
choices.help: Views are one after the other

options.what: How the two views are packed into one frame (default sbs).

framerate.what: Raise or lower the frame rate by blending neighbouring frames.
framerate.ffmpeg: Upsamples or downsamples progressive source between specified frame rates.

options.name: fps
options.help: required output frames per second rate
options.what: The frames per second of the output. The default is 50.

options.name: interp_start
options.what: The start of the range, from 0 to 255, where an output frame is made as a linear blend of two frames. The default is 15.

options.name: interp_end
options.what: The end of the range, from 0 to 255, where an output frame is made as a linear blend of two frames. The default is 240.

options.name: scene
options.what: The level, from 0 to 100, at which a scene change is detected; higher means a new scene is more likely. The default is 8.2.

options.name: flags
options.what: Extra flags that influence the filter. Scene change detection uses the scene change level and is on by default.

framestep.what: Keep every Nth frame: a quick time-lapse look.
framestep.ffmpeg: Select one frame every N frames.

options.name: step
options.what: Keep one frame out of every this many frames.

frc_amf.what: Change the frame rate using an AMD card.

options.name: engine_type
options.what: The engine used to run shaders, DirectX 11 or DirectX 12.

options.name: enable
options.what: Turns the frame rate conversion on or off; it can be changed while running. On by default.

options.name: fallback_mode
options.help: Fallback behavior in case of low interpolation confidence
options.what: What is done when confidence in the interpolated frame is low: duplicate the frame or blend two frames together. The default is blend.

options.name: indicator
options.help: Show FRC indicator square in the top left corner of the video.
options.what: Shows a small square in the top left corner of the video while the conversion is active. Off by default.

options.name: profile

choices.name: low
choices.help: Less levels of hierarchical motion search. Only recommended for extremely low resolutions.

choices.name: high
choices.help: Recommended for any resolution up to 1440p.

choices.name: super
choices.help: More levels of hierarchical motion search. Recommended for resolutions 1440p or higher.

options.what: How many levels of hierarchical motion search are used; the manual recommends low only for extremely low resolutions, high up to 1440p, and super for 1440p or higher. The default is high.

options.name: mv_search_mode
options.help: Performance mode of the motion search

choices.name: native
choices.help: Conduct motion search on the full resolution of source images.
choices.plain: Conduct motion search on the full resolution of source images

choices.name: performance
choices.help: Conduct motion search on the down scaled source images. Recommended for APU or low end GPU for better performance.
choices.plain: Down scaled images (APU or low end GPU)

options.name: use_future_frame
options.help: Enable dependency on future frame, improves quality for the cost of latency

freezedetect.why: Measurements and diagnostics: they report on the picture, they do not change it
freezedetect.what: Report the moments where the picture stops moving.

options.name: noise
options.what: How much change is still counted as no change, as a ratio from 0 to 1 or in dB. The default is 0.001, which is -60dB.

options.name: duration
options.what: How long the picture must stay frozen before it is reported. The default is 2 seconds.

freezeframes.what: Replace a range of frames of the first video with one frame of the second.

options.name: first
options.what: The number of the first frame from which the freeze starts.

options.name: last
options.what: The number of the last frame at which the freeze ends.

options.name: replace
options.what: The number of the frame from the second input that is shown instead of the frozen frames.

fspp.what: A post-processing filter against block and ringing artefacts.

options.name: quality
options.what: The number of levels used for averaging, from 4 to 5. The default is 4.

options.name: qp
options.what: Forces a constant quantization parameter, from 0 to 63. If not set, the value from the video stream is used when available.

options.name: strength

options.name: use_bframe_qp
options.what: Uses the quantization parameter from B-frames, which may cause flicker because they often have larger values. Off by default.

fsync.why: Internal plumbing: they change how ffmpeg handles the picture, not what it looks like
fsync.ffmpeg: Synchronize video frames from external source.
fsync.what: Keep the frames in step with timestamps from a file.

options.name: file
options.help: set the file name to use for frame sync
options.what: The file that maps input timestamps to the frames to drop or create.

gblur.what: A smooth blur of a strength you choose.

options.name: sigma
options.what: How strongly the picture is blurred.

options.name: steps
options.what: How many steps the Gaussian approximation uses.

options.name: planes
options.what: Which colour planes are blurred, as a bit mask. By default all of them.

options.name: sigmaV
options.what: The blur strength in the vertical direction. Negative means the same as the horizontal one.

geq.what: Compute every pixel from a formula.
geq.ffmpeg: Apply generic equation to each pixel.

options.name: lum_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the brightness of each pixel.

options.name: cb_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the blue chrominance of each pixel.

options.name: cr_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the red chrominance of each pixel.

options.name: alpha_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the transparency of each pixel.

options.name: red_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the red value of each pixel.

options.name: green_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the green value of each pixel.

options.name: blue_expr
options.what: The expression that gives the blue value of each pixel.

options.name: interpolation
options.what: The interpolation method used when sampling between pixels. The default is bilinear.

gfxcapture.why: Inputs and outputs of a filter graph: not effects
gfxcapture.ffmpeg: Capture graphics/screen content as a video source
gfxcapture.what: Capture graphics or a screen as a video source.

options.name: window_title

options.what: A regular expression matched against window titles. A (?i) prefix makes it case-insensitive.

options.name: window_class

options.what: As the window title, but matched against the window class name.

options.name: window_exe

options.what: As the window title, but matched against the executable file name of the window's process.

options.name: monitor_idx

options.name: capture_border

options.name: display_border

options.name: hwnd

options.name: hmonitor

options.name: crop_top

options.what: How many pixels are cropped from the top of the captured frames.

options.name: crop_right

options.what: How many pixels are cropped from the right side of the captured frames.

options.name: crop_bottom

options.what: How many pixels are cropped from the bottom of the captured frames.

options.name: premultiplied

choices.name: crop

choices.name: scale

choices.help: scale source to fit initial size while preserving aspect ratio

options.what: The scaling algorithm used when resizing is needed. The default is bilinear.

options.name: output_fmt
options.what: The pixel format inside the D3D11 hardware frames. The default is 8-bit BGRA.

options.help: The maximum amount by which the filter will change any one pixel.

options.name: radius

sharpness_vaapi.what: Sharpen using a Linux graphics card.

options.name: sharpness

shear.what: Shear the picture sideways or up and down.

options.name: shy
options.what: The shear factor in the Y direction, from -2 to 2. Default 0.

options.name: fillcolor
options.what: The colour that fills the area not covered by the transformed video. Default black; none prints no background.

options.name: interp
options.what: Whether bilinear or nearest neighbour interpolation is used. Default bilinear.

showcqt.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song
showcqt.ffmpeg: Convert input audio to a CQT (Constant/Clamped Q Transform) spectrum video output.
showcqt.what: Draw the sound as a piano-style spectrum.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video; it must be even. The default is 1920x1080.

options.name: rate
options.what: The output frame rate. The default is 25.

options.name: bar_h
options.what: The height of the bar graph, which must be even. The default of -1 works it out automatically.

options.name: axis_h
options.what: The height of the axis, which must be even. The default of -1 works it out automatically.

options.name: sono_h
options.what: The height of the sonogram, which must be even. The default of -1 works it out automatically.

options.name: fullhd
options.what: Sets the full HD resolution. Deprecated, use the video size instead. On by default.

options.name: sono_v
options.what: The volume of the sonogram, as an expression. The default is 16.

options.name: bar_v
options.what: The volume of the bar graph, as an expression. The default is sono_v.

options.name: sono_g
options.what: The gamma of the sonogram, from 1 to 7. A lower gamma gives the spectrum more contrast, a higher one gives it more range. The default is 3.

options.name: bar_g
options.what: The gamma of the bar graph, from 1 to 7. The default is 1.

options.name: bar_t
options.what: The transparency level of the bar graph, from 0 to 1. A lower value makes the bar graph sharper. The default is 1.

options.name: timeclamp
options.what: A trade-off at low frequencies: a lower value shows events in time more accurately (like a fast bass drum), otherwise frequency is shown more accurately (like a bass guitar). From 0.002 to 1; the default is 0.17.

options.name: attack
options.what: Limits future samples with asymmetric windowing in time, useful when low latency is required. From 0 to 1; the default 0 disables it.

options.name: basefreq
options.what: The lowest frequency of the transform, from 10 to 100000. The default is 50 cents below E0.

options.name: endfreq
options.what: The highest frequency of the transform, from 10 to 100000. The default is 50 cents above D#10.

options.name: coeffclamp
options.what: This option is deprecated and ignored.

options.name: tlength
options.what: The length of the transform in time, as an expression that can use variables; it controls the trade-off between time and frequency accuracy at each frequency.

options.name: count
options.what: The number of transforms done for every video frame, from 1 to 30. The default is 6.

options.name: fcount
options.what: The number of transforms for every single pixel, from 0 to 10. The default 0 works it out automatically.

options.name: fontfile
options.what: The font file used with freetype to draw the axis. If empty, the embedded font is used.

options.name: font
options.what: A fontconfig pattern for the axis font. The font file takes priority over it.

options.name: fontcolor
options.what: An expression that gives the font colour as an integer 0xRRGGBB. It can use variables and functions.

options.name: axisfile
options.what: An image file used to draw the axis. It overrides the font file and font colour options.

options.name: axis
options.what: Whether text is drawn on the axis. If off, the font file and axis image are ignored. On by default.

options.name: csp
options.what: The colour space of the output. The default is unspecified.

options.name: cscheme
options.what: The spectrogram colour scheme, as a list of six values in the form left_r|left_g|left_b|right_r|right_g|right_b. The default is 1|0.5|0|0|0.5|1.

showcwt.why: Audio into a picture (waves, spectrum, scopes): another job, a video made from a song

options.name: size

options.name: rate
options.what: The output frame rate, as a number or an expression. The default is 25.

options.name: scale
options.what: The frequency scale used. The default is linear.

options.name: iscale

options.name: min
options.what: The lowest frequency shown in the output, from 1 to 192000. The default is 20.

options.name: max

options.name: imin
options.what: The lowest intensity used in the output, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: imax
options.what: The highest intensity used in the output, from 0 to 1. The default is 1.

options.name: logb
options.what: The logarithmic basis for brightness strength when mapping magnitudes to pixel values, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.0001.

options.name: deviation
options.what: Values below 1 favour frequency detail, values above 1 favour time detail. The default is 1.

options.name: pps
options.what: The number of pixels output per second in one row, from 1 to 1024. The default is 64.

options.name: mode
options.what: What the output shows. The default is magnitude.

options.name: slide
options.what: How the picture moves along as time passes. The default is replace.

options.name: direction
options.what: The direction of the slide method.

options.name: bar
options.what: The ratio of the bar graph display to the display size, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: rotation
options.what: Rotates the colours, from -1 to 1. The default is 0.

options.name: size
options.what: The size of the output video. The default is 1024x512.

options.name: rate
options.what: The video frame rate. The default is 25.

options.name: mode
options.what: How each frequency bin is shown. The default is bar.

options.name: ascale
options.what: The scale for amplitude. The default is log.

options.name: fscale
options.what: The scale for frequency. The default is lin.

options.name: win_size
options.what: The analysis window size, from 16 to 65536. The default is 2048.

options.name: win_func
options.what: The windowing function. The default is hanning.

options.name: overlap
options.what: How much the windows overlap, from 0 to 1. The default of 1 picks the optimal overlap for the chosen window function.

options.name: colors

options.name: minamp

options.name: data

options.name: channels

options.name: slide

options.what: Whether all channels share one row or each has its own row. The default is combined.

options.name: color
options.what: How colours are chosen. The default is channel.

options.name: scale
options.what: The scale used to calculate intensity colour values. The default is sqrt.

options.name: fscale
options.what: The frequency scale. The default is lin.

options.name: win_func

options.name: orientation

options.name: gain

options.name: rotation

options.name: fps

options.name: legend

options.name: drange

options.name: limit

options.name: rate
options.what: The frame rate of the video the meter is drawn in. Default 25.

options.name: b
options.what: The width of the border around each meter, from 0 to 5. Default 1.

options.name: w
options.what: The width of each channel's meter, from 80 to 8192. Default 400.

options.name: h
options.what: The height of each channel's meter, from 1 to 900. Default 20.

options.name: f
options.what: How the meter fades over time, from 0 to 1. Default 0.95.

options.name: c

options.name: v

options.name: dm

options.name: dmc
options.help: set color of the max value line

options.name: o

options.name: s

options.name: p

options.name: m

options.name: ds

options.name: mode

options.name: width

sidechaincompress.what: Lower one sound while another is loud: ducking music under speech.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The gain applied to the input before compressing. Default 1, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mode
options.what: Whether the compressor works downward or upward. Default is downward.

options.name: threshold
options.what: The level above which the second stream starts to reduce the gain of the first stream. Default 0.125, from 0.000976563 to 1.

options.name: ratio
options.what: How strongly the signal is reduced above the threshold. Default 2, from 1 to 20.

options.name: attack
options.what: How long the signal must stay above the threshold before gain reduction starts. Default 20 milliseconds, from 0.01 to 2000.

options.name: release
options.what: How long the signal must stay below the threshold before the reduction is eased off again. Default 250 milliseconds, from 0.01 to 9000.

options.name: makeup
options.what: How much the signal is amplified after processing. Default 1, from 1 to 64.

options.name: knee
options.what: Rounds off the sharp corner around the threshold so gain reduction starts more softly. Default 2.82843, from 1 to 8.

options.name: link
options.what: Whether the average level of all side-chain channels or the loudest side-chain channel drives the reduction. Default is average.

options.name: detection
options.what: Whether the exact signal (peak) or a smoother RMS measure is used for detection. Default is rms.

options.name: level_sc
options.what: The gain applied to the side-chain (second) stream. Default 1, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mix
options.what: How much of the compressed signal is used in the output. Default 1, from 0 to 1.

sidechaingate.what: Open the gate on one sound when another is loud.

options.name: level_in
options.what: The level applied to the input before filtering. Default 1, from 0.015625 to 64.

options.name: mode

choices.name: downward
choices.plain: Reduce the lower parts of the signal

choices.name: upward
choices.plain: Amplify the higher parts of the signal

options.what: Downward lowers the quiet parts of the signal; upward amplifies the louder parts, widening the dynamic range. Default is downward.

options.name: range
options.what: The level of gain reduction when the signal is below the threshold. Default 0.06125, from 0 to 1; 0 disables the reduction so the filter acts like an expander.

options.name: threshold
options.what: When the signal rises above this level, the gain reduction is released. Default 0.125, from 0 to 1.

options.name: ratio
options.what: How strongly the signal is reduced. Default 2, from 1 to 9000.

options.name: attack
